prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
New interactive flows (new_flow) generated the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several flow additions caused severe drops (down to -11.8%).
Step reordering (reorder) achieved high-impact wins (up to +12.0%), but carried significant risk, frequently showing no clear effect or causing severe drops (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators (wait_info) produced multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), at times exceeding optimistic predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), though the majority of copy tests produced no clear effect.
UI redesigns, layout changes, hints, notifications, and standalone preview screens failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -14.1%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant declines.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +2.1% over 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +3.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +2.6% over 4 test(s)
- finish, layout: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -1.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -4.9% over 3 test(s)
- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +1.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% over 7 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +2.5% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.1% over 9 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 77.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 33.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Shift Sign-In Step Right Before Final Home Introduction: Moves the sign-in step to occur after waiting pet generation completes, right before final desktop introduction. (why: Sign-in sits early before waiting asset rendering, creating friction. Moving sign-in to after waiting lets users see their pet build before creating/verifying credentials.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Companion Selection: Redesigns the pet selection screen into an immersive interactive stage layout with full-size preview cards. (why: Adoption stage has a 77.1% conversion rate with long completion times (mean 1017s). A stage visual layout makes selecting a companion clearer and faster.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Render Progress Breakdown & Timer: Displays live rendering progress breakdown with explicit estimated time remaining on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend up to 2336s on average in the waiting stage without clear feedback on render progress.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Switch: Enables a system tray desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen when asset preparation finishes. (why: The average waiting duration of 2336s causes users to switch away to other desktop apps while waiting.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Flexibility Reassurance Hint: Adds a hint on path selection reassuring users that chosen playstyles can be altered anytime later. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite 78.3% conversion, showing heavy hesitation before choosing.)

scores.note: Sign-in step reordering is high-risk and has shown negligible historical gains (+0.1% over 9 tests).
Adoption has high drop-off and long times, but UI redesigns consistently fail (-12.5% historical average).
Wait-state info consistently delivers solid positive results, especially for high-wait steps like home.
Desktop notifications require OS integration cost and historical notification tests failed (-1.3%).
Very low cost config change, but hints have historically failed to produce wins (-3.1% on choose_path).
